schema: Add objects to the `items` array — same shape as below.

items.name: Avocado-focused meal plan
items.summary: Healthy fats, fiber; use as template and adjust calories with your coach.

items.summary: 5-6 meals/day, ~3000 kcal, 200g+ protein. Rice, chicken, eggs, whey.

items.name: Caloric Deficit Fat-Loss
items.summary: 500 kcal deficit, ~1800 kcal, high protein to preserve muscle.

items.name: Ketogenic Diet
items.summary: High fat, very low carb. Keeps insulin low for fat burning.

items.name: Vegetarian Athlete Plan
items.summary: Plant-based complete proteins for active vegetarians.

items.name: Vegan Performance Plan
items.summary: 100% plant-based, optimized with B12 and iron sources.

items.name: Mediterranean Diet
items.summary: Heart-healthy, anti-inflammatory. Excellent for endurance athletes.

items.name: Carb Cycling Plan
items.summary: High carb on training days, low carb on rest days for body recomp.

items.name: Endurance Athlete Fuel
items.summary: High carb, moderate protein for marathon runners and cyclists.

items.name: Intermittent Fasting (16:8)
items.summary: Eat within 8-hour window. Helps fat loss while preserving muscle.
